document: Local farmers reported a record apple harvest this autumn. Mild weather and fewer pests helped yields. Prices at markets have fallen as supply increased.
summary: Farmers report record apple harvest as prices fall.

document: Health officials launched a vaccination campaign for children before winter. Clinics will open on weekends. Parents can book appointments online.
summary: Officials launch winter vaccination campaign for children.

document: The museum reopened after a two year renovation. New galleries display ancient pottery and textiles. Entry will be free for the first month.
summary: Museum reopens after renovation with free entry for a month.

document: The software company released an update fixing a bug that deleted user files. The flaw affected about two percent of customers. The company apologised and offered free storage.
summary: Software update fixes file-deleting bug; company apologises to users.

document: The national team won the football tournament after a penalty shootout. The goalkeeper saved two penalties. Thousands of fans celebrated in the streets overnight.
summary: National team wins tournament on penalties as fans celebrate.

document: The electric car maker opened a new factory that will employ three thousand workers. The plant will build batteries and vehicles. Production starts next spring.
summary: Electric car maker opens factory creating three thousand jobs.

document: Heavy snow closed schools and roads across the north. Trains were cancelled and flights delayed. Forecasters expect more snow later this week.
summary: Heavy snow shuts schools and disrupts travel in the north.

document: Scientists discovered a new species of frog in the rainforest. The tiny frog is smaller than a fingernail. Researchers say the area needs protection from logging.
summary: Scientists find tiny new frog species in threatened rainforest.

document: The airline announced new direct flights to five cities. Tickets go on sale next week. The airline expects strong demand during the holidays.
summary: Airline adds direct flights to five new cities.
